title: pseudognaphalium ephemerum
intro: Pseudognaphalium ephemerum, commonly known as Western Marsh-elder, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb native to North America, valued for its medicinal properties. Pseudognaphalium ephemerum is used to treat various health issues, including its potential to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
